summary: First version. All figures checked against Public Health Scotland, NHS England (via the House of Commons Library), IFS, Audit Scotland, ONS, NRS, Nuffield Trust, Health Foundation and King's Fund sources.
England's share of waits over a year updated to about 1.5% (Aug 2026). An earlier draft used an older 3.5% figure.
Scotland's long waits updated to May 2026. An earlier draft used December 2025 figures, before a large fall.
Delayed discharge comparison revised. Per person, Scotland has roughly twice England's rate, not the same rate.
Free personal care pays a fixed weekly sum in care homes. Accommodation costs are still means-tested.
Some England 18-week trend points come from secondary reports of NHS England data. Replace with the NHS England RTT overview timeseries at the next update.
